# Termux-Diffusion Full Technical Specification (v1.6.6)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Pure CPU Native On-Device Stable Diffusion Runtime for Android Termux
Executes quantized Stable Diffusion models with ARMv8.2-A DotProd/FP16 NEON SIMD vector instructions, VAE tiling, and direct Android MediaStore synchronization.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-diffusion
- Command: pip install termux-diffusion && termux-diffusion install
# or:
npm install termux-diffusion && npx termux-diffusion install
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-diffusion
